agent_review.author: agent

findings.summary: The authoritative clone whited out against Dustox; qualification resets to clone 1.

At the first Eelektrik boundary, Bushtank is the only current switch above the verified critical survival bound; the intended Croakatoa and Bugatti pivots are unsafe, so the unchanged team has no reliable status-immune Eelektrik answer.

resolution.observed: The safety replay preserved the critical-switch veto and blocked the unchanged six. ROM/UI checks then proved Budew unreachable before the next badge; preparation replaced Bushtank with the verified boxed Coppertop, retained Bugatti, and created a new exact opening/profile for Clone 1.

findings.summary: Bushtank remained for four Eelektrik actions, became badly poisoned, lost one Razor Leaf to the deterministic miss, and fainted; Birdlaw then spent two attacks into super-effective Shock Wave and fainted, consuming the planned Dustox finisher.

With Birdlaw gone, Bugatti had to finish Eelektrik and was then trapped and fainted against Dustox; Croakatoa followed with four low-impact Mud Shots while Dustox repeatedly Roosted and healed with Black Sludge.
Only three of seven switches were voluntary and none formed a no-action repeat-switch loop; the new spam veto worked. The loss came from choosing the wrong phase resources, not raw switch count.
After the Eelektrik relay, the remaining damaged team entered Dustox sequentially with no preserved super-effective attacker; each later faint was a consequence of the earlier reserve loss.

correct_choices: Do not retry this six unchanged.
Use the reachable Poison-immune Coppertop as the Eelektrik converter while preserving Birdlaw for Dustox and Bugatti for Sunflora; defer Budew until Fly or the Route 103 water connection is unlocked.
Retain the generic unsafe-switch and repeat-switch vetoes; planned Fake Out pivots remain allowed only with a verified safe continuation.
agent_review.next_test: Run Clone 1 from the exact Coppertop+Bugatti Route 110 precontact checkpoint and verify that Coppertop absorbs Eelektrik without consuming Birdlaw or Bugatti.
